Place & perspective

A considered view of Makkah.

Makkah brings a distinctive architectural identity to a photography brief. Its built environment connects religious significance, local heritage and the landscape around the city. For a hotel or architectural commission, this context helps frame the conversation about the atmosphere a collection should communicate.

01

Hotel photography in Makkah

The Fairmont Makkah project is the Saudi Arabia reference currently presented in the Charlot Crea portfolio. The selected gallery gives visitors a concrete starting point for discussing hotel photography in Makkah. Explore the photographs, then share the spaces, audience and intended uses behind your own project.

02

Architecture and interior photography

A useful architectural collection can connect the overall character of a building with its interior proportions, materials and details. The brief should identify which spaces matter most and how the photographs will be used. Website layouts, presentations and printed material can require different selections and formats.

03

Planning a Saudi Arabia photography project

Charlot Crea is based in Antalya, Türkiye, and works internationally. Share the exact location, proposed dates, access arrangements and priority photographs when discussing a Saudi Arabia shoot. Scope, travel and delivery are agreed around the location and requirements of each commission.

Planning the shoot

Which Saudi Arabia project can I explore?

The current collection features Fairmont Makkah. Its project page contains the published selection of photographs.

What should a Makkah photography brief include?

Include the property or company name, exact location, priority spaces, intended use of the images, preferred dates and the contact coordinating access.
